AP's jowar output has fallen — now Rajasthan (567 thousand t, 2022-23) is ahead of UP and AP among these options (PIB, Dec 2023)
Undivided Andhra Pradesh was long a major jowar State (Maharashtra and Karnataka lead). (now Rajasthan, 567 thousand t in 2022-23, outranks UP, 315, and AP, 284)

exam: APPSC Forest Section Officer Screening Test General Studies
q: Rice Tungro disease is caused by
explanation: Rice tungro is a viral disease caused by two viruses together (rice tungro bacilliform and spherical viruses), spread by green leafhoppers; Xanthomonas causes bacterial blight and Pyricularia causes blast.

exam: APPSC Animal Husbandry Department General Studies & Mental A
q: Which fodder is more suitable for silage making
explanation: Maize is the most suitable fodder for silage (high sugar/starch, good fermentation); lucerne and cowpea are legumes that ensile poorly, napier is less suited.

notes.text: - India short of **pulses**, not of protein, because of high demand (keyed: R explains A).
